title: A SCALAR INT64 VAL parameter rounds 3.5 to 4
query: DEFINE FUNCTION CastToInt = ( x : SCALAR INT64 VAL ) => x

source.quote: This uses a Scalar type, Int64 subtype, and val parameterMode for predictable rounding and text-to-number coercion
source.supports: the page shows CastToInt ( 3.4 ), CastToInt ( 3.5 ), CastToInt ( "5" ) returning 3, 4, 5
the SQLBI article describes the cast as INT, which rounds down

derivation: The Microsoft page gives 3, 4, 5 for the arguments 3.4, 3.5 and "5" in one query; this is the second of them alone. 4 means the cast rounds to the nearest integer.
alternative: The SQLBI article describes the same cast as INT ( ... ), which rounds down. In that reading CastToInt ( 3.5 ) is 3.
